tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Page ground. The sky-teal behind everything; cards float on it. Text on it is ink, never white body copy.

tokens.name: teal-mist
tokens.usage: Lighter teal for the lower sweep of the ground, wells and quiet fills. Ink text only.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Decorative only: giant ghost letterforms and + sparkles on the teal ground. Never carries text that must be read.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Floating cards, search field, pill buttons. Ink, ink-muted, ink-teal and orange-text are legible on it in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on surface and on teal (7.7:1 on teal in light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions such as 'Price (dollar/$) :' and placeholder text, on surface only (fails on teal).

tokens.name: ink-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary line under a card title (the artist under a track). On surface only.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Cub orange. Primary actions, price pills, equalizer bars, app tiles. Text on it is on-orange.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an orange fill (6.4:1). The poster sets white on orange; that pair is 2.3:1 and fails, so white is kept for glyph tiles of 32px+ only.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text or link on surface (5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Media and secondary actions: play tile, MORE pill, footer band, the second square of a swatch pair.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on navy.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Scooter green from the illustration. Accents and illustration only; never a UI state.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The rare divider inside a card. The system prefers space to rules.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring outside the element with a 2px gap in the ground colour. Navy reads on teal, white and orange.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the page subject, stacked on two lines over the teal ground.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card titles in ink. Heavy and tight.

styles.name: card-subtitle
styles.usage: Line under a card title, in ink-teal.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Koguma lives by herself and rides a Super Cub to school.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels and meta, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label-tracked
styles.usage: Lowercase, wide-tracked labels on pill controls and placeholders.

styles.name: micro-caps
styles.usage: Tiny spaced capitals on navy pills.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price inside an orange pill. Comma decimals, dot thousands, currency after.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label, bar gaps in the equalizer.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tile gaps inside the app-grid glyph; title to subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill button inner padding (vertical x2).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked elements in a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between floating cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens; section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner tiles of the app-grid glyph, thumbnails' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small square chips (the orange/navy swatch pair), thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large icon tiles (app grid, play).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search field, price pills, name tags.
